analysis_questions.question: Overall: number of tickets -> ticket_count; mean resolution_minutes -> mean_resolution_minutes; sum of labor_cost -> total_labor_cost.
Team comparison: total labor_cost for Alpha, Beta and Gamma -> labor_cost_alpha, labor_cost_beta, labor_cost_gamma.
Channel comparison: mean resolution_minutes by channel -> resolution_email, resolution_chat, resolution_phone.
Reopening change: reopened percentage for email and chat -> reopen_rate_email_pct, reopen_rate_chat_pct; (email rate - chat rate) / chat rate * 100 -> email_vs_chat_reopen_change_pct.

High-cost low-satisfaction segment: tickets with labor_cost >= 100 and a non-missing satisfaction_score <= 2 -> count and reopened percentage as high_cost_low_sat_count and high_cost_low_sat_reopen_pct.

Distribution: median and sample standard deviation of resolution_minutes -> resolution_median, resolution_std; mean non-missing satisfaction_score -> satisfaction_mean; missing satisfaction count -> satisfaction_missing_count.

Agent concentration (derived step): distinct agent_id count -> unique_agent_count; largest ticket count for one agent -> top_agent_ticket_count; top_agent_ticket_count / ticket_count * 100 -> top_agent_ticket_share_pct.

cleaning_requirements: R1. Read both tickets.csv and agents.csv as text. Strip whitespace. Treat empty, NA, N/A, null, None and - as missing.
R2. In tickets.csv, remove duplicate ticket_id rows before any filtering; keep the first in raw-file order.
R3. In agents.csv, normalise agent_id to upper case and remove duplicate agent_id rows, keeping the first.

R4. Agent roster: map team case-insensitively from Alpha/Team Alpha, Beta/Team Beta, Gamma/Team Gamma; map region East/E and West/W; parse hourly_cost after removing $, USD and commas. Exclude roster rows with an invalid field or cost <= 0.
R5. Tickets: normalise agent_id to upper case. Join to the cleaned agent roster by agent_id and drop tickets without a matching agent.
R6. Map channel case-insensitively: Email/E-mail -> email, Chat/Live Chat -> chat, Phone/Call -> phone. Drop invalid channels.
R7. resolution_minutes: remove a trailing 'min' or 'minutes', parse a whole number from 1 through 480, and drop invalid rows.
R8. satisfaction_score: parse a whole number from 1 through 5. Invalid or missing values become an empty cell and the row is kept.
R9. reopened: map Yes/Y/True/1 to 1 and No/N/False/0 to 0, case-insensitively. Drop invalid or missing values.
R10. Add labor_cost = resolution_minutes / 60 * hourly_cost, rounded to 2 decimals.
R11. Output exactly: ticket_id, agent_id, team, region, channel, resolution_minutes, satisfaction_score, reopened, hourly_cost, labor_cost. Sort by ticket_id and write CSV without an index.
notes: SYNTHETIC two-file join. Later duplicate tickets deliberately disagree in value; roster and ticket fields contain case, whitespace, currency, unit and missing-value variants.
objective: Clean and join a support-ticket export with an agent roster, analyse cost, speed, reopening, satisfaction and agent concentration, then report verified findings.
